verdict.rationale: The pricing page states "$5 free credit for new users. No credit card required", and lists transparent per-second, usage-based rates with no one-hour minimum. The get-started docs show a self-serve path: install the SDK and create a team-scoped API key, with no sales contact mentioned. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation of the self-serve signup and credit flow, and documentation of how long the credit lasts or what limits apply once it runs out.
